title: 馬克白 1-2 戰報
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, dark fantasy atmosphere
characters: Macbeth, a broad-shouldered warrior in dark plate armor, shoulder-length black hair, short black beard, a pale diagonal scar across his left cheek

panels.prompt: wide establishing shot, medieval Scottish military camp near Forres at dawn after battle, smoke drifting over tents and tattered war banners, crows circling in a pale sky, no characters

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.text: 福累斯附近的軍營。戰火剛歇。
dialogue.en: A camp near Forres. The battle has just ended.

panels.prompt: elderly King Duncan with a long white beard, gold crown, fur-trimmed deep blue robe, standing before the royal tent with young prince Malcolm, clean-shaven, short fair hair, thin gold circlet, both turning toward something off-panel

dialogue.speaker: 鄧肯
dialogue.text: 那個渾身是血的人是誰？看他的樣子，該有前線最新的消息。
dialogue.en: What bloody man is that? He can report, as seemeth by his plight, of the revolt the newest state.

panels.prompt: a blood-soaked sergeant with a bandaged brow and blood-streaked face staggering forward supported by a young soldier, cold dawn light

dialogue.speaker: 馬爾康
dialogue.text: 是他！當初奮戰救我突圍的軍曹。勇敢的朋友，把你離開時的戰況稟告王上！
dialogue.en: This is the sergeant who like a good and hardy soldier fought 'gainst my captivity. Hail, brave friend!

panels.prompt: close-up of a blood-soaked sergeant's face, bandaged brow, blood-streaked cheek, speaking through gritted teeth

dialogue.speaker: 軍曹
dialogue.text: 勝負未分——兩軍像兩個力竭的泳者扭抱在一起，誰也使不出本事。
dialogue.en: Doubtful it stood, as two spent swimmers that do cling together and choke their art.

panels.prompt: flashback battle scene, chaotic melee of highland rebels on a misty moor, a hulking rebel chieftain laughing amid the slaughter, a spectral wheel of fortune looming in the storm clouds above him

dialogue.speaker: 軍曹（旁白）
dialogue.text: 叛徒麥克唐華德——天下的奸惡都聚在他一身，連命運都像娼妓一樣對他賣笑。
dialogue.en: The merciless Macdonwald—worthy to be a rebel—and Fortune, on his damned quarrel smiling, showed like a rebel's whore.

panels.prompt: flashback, {characters}, carving a path through enemy soldiers with a greatsword smoking with blood, bodies falling aside, dramatic backlight through battle smoke, like the personification of valor

dialogue.speaker: 軍曹（旁白）
dialogue.text: 可是英勇的馬克白——他當得起這名字——根本不把命運放在眼裡。他揮著染血的劍，像煞星一樣殺開一條路，直取那奴才面前！
dialogue.en: For brave Macbeth—well he deserves that name—disdaining Fortune, with his brandished steel, which smoked with bloody execution, like valor's minion carved out his passage till he faced the slave.

panels.prompt: stark silhouette of a sword thrust against blinding white, then a severed head mounted on castle battlements against a grey sky, crows perched nearby

dialogue.speaker: 軍曹
dialogue.text: 不行禮，不搭話，一劍從肚臍剖到下巴——那顆頭，已經掛上我們的城樓。
dialogue.en: He unseamed him from the nave to th' chops, and fixed his head upon our battlements.

dialogue.speaker: 鄧肯
dialogue.text: 啊，英勇的表弟！尊貴的壯士！

panels.prompt: flashback, fresh Norwegian troops in gleaming armor pouring over a ridge under storm clouds, banners with a sea-raven emblem, spears like a forest

dialogue.speaker: 軍曹
dialogue.text: 但風暴偏從東方捲來——挪威王看準時機，率一批甲械精良的生力軍，發動新一波猛攻！
dialogue.en: The Norweyan lord, surveying vantage, with furbished arms and new supplies of men began a fresh assault.

panels.prompt: close-up of elderly King Duncan's worried face, long white beard, gripping the fur trim of his robe

dialogue.speaker: 鄧肯
dialogue.text: 我們的將軍——馬克白和班柯，沒有因此膽怯吧？
dialogue.en: Dismayed not this our captains, Macbeth and Banquo?

panels.prompt: flashback, {characters} fighting back to back with Banquo, a sturdy warrior with a thick braided beard, a raven feather pinned at his shoulder, both swinging swords against a wall of enemies, sparks of clashing steel

dialogue.speaker: 軍曹
dialogue.text: 膽怯？除非麻雀嚇得退老鷹、兔子嚇得走雄獅！他們像裝了雙倍火藥的巨炮，愈打愈猛——咳……我不行了，傷口得治……
dialogue.en: Yes, as sparrows eagles, or the hare the lion... as cannons overcharged with double cracks. But I am faint; my gashes cry for help.

dialogue.speaker: 鄧肯
dialogue.text: 你的話和你的傷一樣，都透著戰士的光榮。送他去軍醫！
dialogue.en: So well thy words become thee as thy wounds: they smack of honor both. Go get him surgeons.

panels.prompt: thane Ross, a gaunt middle-aged nobleman in a long travel-stained grey cloak, striding urgently into the royal camp, wind whipping the tent flaps, wide alarmed eyes

dialogue.speaker: 列諾克斯
dialogue.text: 瞧他眼裡的慌張——像有天大的事要說。
dialogue.en: What a haste looks through his eyes! So should he look that seems to speak things strange.

panels.prompt: flashback, epic duel between {characters} and an armored Norwegian king on a corpse-strewn field at Fife, dark foreign banners filling the sky behind them

dialogue.speaker: 洛斯
dialogue.text: 在費輔，挪威王親率大軍，還有叛徒考特爵士相助——但馬克白披甲迎戰，刀來槍往，硬是挫了他的凶焰。勝利是我們的！
dialogue.en: Norway himself, with terrible numbers, assisted by that most disloyal traitor the Thane of Cawdor... the victory fell on us.

panels.prompt: the defeated Norwegian king kneeling, offering a chest of coins, grim Scottish soldiers standing over him in the fog

dialogue.speaker: 洛斯
dialogue.text: 挪威王史威諾求和了。不繳一萬塊錢，就不准他埋葬戰死的將士。
dialogue.en: Sweno, the Norways' king, craves composition. Nor would we deign him burial of his men till he disbursed ten thousand dollars.

panels.prompt: elderly King Duncan with a long white beard, gold crown, fur-trimmed deep blue robe, rising to pronounce judgment with one arm extended, torchlight casting long shadows across the war tent, attendants bowing

dialogue.speaker: 鄧肯
dialogue.text: 考特爵士再也騙不了我。傳令——立即處死。他的爵位，移贈馬克白。
dialogue.en: No more that Thane of Cawdor shall deceive our bosom interest. Go pronounce his present death, and with his former title greet Macbeth.

quote.text: 他所失去的，也就是尊貴的馬克白所得到的
quote.en: What he hath lost, noble Macbeth hath won.

panels.prompt: narrow closing panel, a jeweled thane's chain and a wax-sealed decree lying on a map of Scotland, beyond the tent opening a distant moor wreathed in fog

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.text: 一個頭銜換了主人。而荒野上，有三雙眼睛正等著它的新主人……
dialogue.en: A title changes hands. And out on the heath, three pairs of eyes await its new owner…
